note: These are configurable conventional paths, not guarantees of permanent vendor behavior. Use --dest when the local installation differs. 'loading_mode' describes the actual skill loading behavior of the runtime: 'lazy' means skill SKILL.md content is loaded only when the skill is explicitly invoked or referenced; 'eager' means all installed skill content is injected into the context at startup; 'unknown' means the pack cannot determine the behavior without testing.

antigravity.notes: Antigravity IDE. Skills are listed in system instructions by name; SKILL.md content is loaded on demand when the skill is invoked. Workspace path is .agents/skills; global path is ~/.gemini/config/skills.

antigravity-cli.notes: Antigravity CLI. Skills are listed by name; SKILL.md content is loaded on demand when the skill is invoked. Workspace path is .agents/skills; global path is ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills.
